How do I use it properly the very first time?
To use your new UPF 50+ shift dress properly for the first time, simply put it on just like any everyday dress—no special prep or activation is needed, as the sun protection is built right into the fabric!
For care, machine wash it in cold water and lay it flat to dry in the shade (avoid drying in direct sunlight or the dryer). Be sure to avoid sunscreens containing avobenzone, as it can stain the fabric.
